FRI 13:05

Request

Opens Q-17 and links the change.

Sees a green build and a review request.

Checks pass. The default roster adds a team tag.

FRI 13:12

Route

Assumes the team tag means it is assigned.

Primary reviewer is covering support.

Team notification lands. No one accepts ownership.

FRI 15:40

Escalate

Posts a second nudge in the team channel.

Backup sees the nudge after their shift.

No timeout, rotation or acknowledgement exists.

MON 09:10

Recover

Reposts Q-17 in the Monday stand-up.

Day lead claims it and begins review.

Queue finally records a named reviewer.
